signaling_summary: All-digital SSTL_15 (Stub-Series Terminated Logic at 1.5 V) signaling. Command/address/control are single-ended SSTL_15; CK/CK# and DQS/DQS# are differential SSTL_15. DQ inputs/outputs are single-ended SSTL_15 referenced to VREFDQ; CA inputs are single-ended SSTL_15 referenced to VREFCA. VREFDQ and VREFCA shall be set to VDDQ/2 and VDD/2 nominally and must remain valid during Self-Refresh. ZQ pin provides a calibration reference against a 240 Ω ±1% external resistor that the on-die calibration engine uses to trim output driver (Ron) and on-die termination (Rtt) impedance for Process / Voltage / Temperature variation.

differential_input_thresholds_CK_DQS.Vix_AC: Crossing point of CK and CK# (and DQS / DQS#) must remain within ±150 mV of VDD/2 over the AC region

output_driver_impedance_RZQ.RZQ_tolerance: ±1% external resistor on ZQ pin to ground

zq_calibration.purpose: Periodically trim DRAM output driver Ron and ODT Rtt to compensate for voltage and temperature drift.
zq_calibration.external_resistor: 240 Ω ±1% between ZQ pin and ground; one resistor per SDRAM or one shared between two SDRAMs if ZQ timings do not overlap.
zq_calibration.ZQCL_long: tZQinit ≥ 512 nCK after reset (full initial calibration); tZQoper ≥ 256 nCK after operation (full re-calibration).
zq_calibration.ZQCS_short: tZQCS ≥ 64 nCK; corrects ≥ 0.5% of Ron/Rtt error per call.
zq_calibration.drift_compensation_formula: ZQCS interval = ZQCorrection / (TSens × Tdriftrate + VSens × Vdriftrate)
zq_calibration.example_at_1C_per_sec_and_15mV_per_sec: ≈128 ms between ZQCS for typical TSens=1.5%/°C, VSens=0.15%/mV

notes: Although the DDR3 bus is digital, the DRAM array itself is fundamentally analog: 1T1C cells, sense amplifiers, charge-pumps for VPP/VBB, on-die DLL, and ZQ calibration engine. Those internal analog details are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope of this JEDEC standard, which deals only with the bus-level signaling at the package balls.
